NERVE:
I Organ of sensation: शिराः v.
Also sinew.
II Strength, vigour: q. v.:
घैर्यम्।

NERVOUS:
I Lit.: शिरालः (ला, लं).
II Vi-
-gorous: q. v.
III Easily agitated: सहज-
चकितः (ता, तं) (?).

NERVOUSLY:
I Weakly: expr. by adj.
II
Strongly: q. v.

NERVOUSNESS:
I Vigour, strength, as of
style: ओजस् (n.), K.
II. Weakness of ner-
-ves: सहजचकितता (?).
